Why Most Meta Ads Underperform

We've audited over 200 ad accounts. The same problems show up again and again, and they all drain budget quietly. Our system is built to fix every one of them in the first weeks of an engagement.

Tracking broke and nobody noticed

iOS privacy changes gutted browser-based tracking. Most accounts are feeding Meta bad data, so the algorithm optimizes toward the wrong people.

One or two creatives run until they die

Creative is the biggest lever on Meta. Without a structured testing engine, ads fatigue, costs climb, and nobody knows what to launch next.

Boosted posts instead of real structure

Boosting posts and guessing at interests is not a strategy. Winning accounts are built on deliberate campaign structure and audience architecture.

Reports full of vanity metrics

Reach and engagement look nice in a PDF. If reporting is not tied to leads and revenue, you cannot tell whether the ads are actually working.

Meta Ads Questions

What is included in Creekside Marketing's Meta Ads management?
Our Meta Ads management includes end-to-end campaign management, high-quality creative development, compelling ad copy, advanced audience targeting, ongoing A/B testing of ad formats and messaging, and comprehensive performance analysis. We also set up Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI) tracking for precise optimization.
How much does Meta Ads management cost with Creekside Marketing?
Our management fee is a percentage of your ad spend with tiered rates that decrease as your budget grows. Multi-platform advertisers pay the same per-platform rate, and total fees are capped at $15,000/month.
Who manages my Meta Ads campaigns at Creekside?
Cade Maclean, co-founder with an accounting background and MBA, leads Meta Ads strategy. Your campaigns are handled by dedicated Meta Ads specialists. You communicate directly with the person managing your ads. No account managers or middlemen.
What platforms do your Meta Ads run on?
We run ads across Facebook and Instagram through Meta's advertising platform. This includes feed ads, Stories, Reels, and other placements. We test different formats and placements to find what drives the best results for your specific business and audience.
How does Creekside handle conversion tracking for Meta Ads?
We implement Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), and server-side tracking to capture every user interaction from your ads. This ensures accurate attribution even with iOS privacy changes, and gives us the data needed to optimize campaigns toward revenue rather than vanity metrics.
Can Creekside help if I am already running Meta Ads but not seeing results?
Absolutely. We start with our 247-point Profit Recovery Audit to identify the specific mistakes draining your ad budget. Most accounts have 5-7 hidden leaks that take less than 20 minutes to fix. Book a free consultation and we will show you exactly where your money is being wasted.
